verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's own `init` command writes skill folders as SKILL.md files into both Codex (`.agents/skills/ultrametric/SKILL.md`) and Claude Code (`.claude/skills/ultrametric/SKILL.md`). A hands-on dry run confirmed both targets, and the files can be committed and shared, so the same skill format works across more than one vendor's harness. However, the docs never say the skills conform to the open Agent Skills specification. Missing for 10: an explicit claim of conformance to the Agent Skills spec, documentation of SKILL.md frontmatter and folder structure, and evidence of validity in harnesses beyond Codex and Claude Code.
